verdict: Microsoft Policy Platform MOF compilation failed. This almost always indicates an underlying WMI repository issue on the client.
fix: Repair WMI before retrying the client install: run `winmgmt /verifyrepository`. If inconsistent, try `winmgmt /salvagerepository`; if salvage does not resolve it, `winmgmt /resetrepository` is the last-resort fix (destroys the CCM namespace, so follow with `ccmsetup.exe /forceinstall`). Check WBEM event log entries under `Applications and Services Logs / Microsoft / Windows / WMI-Activity / Operational` for the specific MOF file that failed.
